message: Turn 44 fixed at d3ba44798fdf88ff2503bf18c1011b14144d7e6f, Dispatcher 2.2.14. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_blank.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_rebind.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_restore.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_blank.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_rebind.py test_control_page.py test_control_restore.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_blank.py printed test_control_blank: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK and inferTurnRole: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_rebind.py printed test_control_rebind: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_restore.py printed test_control_restore: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Blank-evidence semantics: an equivalent saved control page with messages=0, composer=0, generation inactive, and no sign-in state increments blank_for_url/blank_checks/blank_since. One or two polls do not rebind. Rebind starts only after 6 consecutive matching polls and at least 30 seconds from blank_since. The counter is tied to the exact saved URL and resets on messages, composer readiness, generation, sign-in, a non-matching URL, or a successful rebind. Historical unready_checks is not used. A rendered RU/EN load error still rebinds immediately. The 2.2.13 one-rebind latch is unchanged: one new page, bootstrap once, no unrelated navigation, fail closed without another tab, and recovery/bootstrap/GitHub state preserved. CHECK_INTERVAL stays 5. The 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover is unchanged. Logs contain blank_checks and blank_rebind tokens only, not message text. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
